title: Butterflies (Lepidoptera, Hesperioidea i Papilionoidea) from the collection of the Natural History Museum in Belgrade

facts.label: Кључне речи
facts.value: Природњачки музеј, Београд,Збирка дневних лептира, Каталози

body: This paper presents the collection of butterflies (superfamilies Hesperiodea and Papilionoidea) housed in the Natural History Museum in Belgrade. The butterfly collections are part of the Museum’s rich and well-preserved entomological collection, which includes about 300.000 representatives of all insect group.
